captions.detailed: A countertop soup blender featuring a wide, dark blue-black circular base with a grey interface collar and a black side dial. A transparent, light-blue glass jar with measurement markings sits on the base, holding a four-blade stainless steel assembly at its bottom. The jar is topped with a flat black lid that includes a central, circular steam-vent cap.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a countertop soup blender. The model should feature a wide rounded base with a control dial, a transparent glass blending jar that sits on a grey collar, a four-blade assembly inside the bottom of the jar, and a black lid with a central steam-vent cap.
captions.factory: Construct the blender by first creating the base using a lofted or revolved profile for the main body, adding a cylindrical grey collar and a small box-based control dial on the side. Model the transparent jar using a lofted shell with a hollow interior, attaching small rectangular fins along one side for measurement markings. Create the blade assembly at the bottom using crossed rectangular prisms with angled ends, and cap the jar with a flat cylindrical lid that has a smaller concentric cylinder representing the steam-vent cap.
